# iTracker Charter

Authoritative shared contracts for all feature leaves. Read this before writing any code.

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Backend | Python 3.11, FastAPI, SQLite (WAL mode, raw sqlite3, no ORM) |
| Auth | JWT (HS256) session tokens + PAT Bearer tokens; bcrypt password hashing |
| Search | SQLite FTS5 virtual tables (`issues_fts`, `comments_fts`) |
| WebSocket | Python `websockets` library, standalone asyncio server |
| Frontend | React 18, TypeScript (strict), Vite 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Zustand 5 |
| Router | react-router-dom v6 |
| Package mgmt | `uv` (backend), `npm` (frontend) |

## Port Conventions

| Service | Env var | Default |
|---|---|---|
| REST API | `API_PORT` | 8000 |
| WebSocket | `WS_PORT` | 8001 |
| Frontend Vite | `FRONTEND_PORT` | 5173 |

Frontend env vars: `VITE_API_URL` (default `http://localhost:8000`), `VITE_WS_URL` (default `ws://localhost:8001`).

## Auth Model

- **Session JWT**: created on login/email-verify; stored in `localStorage` as `auth_token`; attached as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` by `api.ts`.
- **PAT**: created in Settings → API Tokens; stored as bcrypt hash in `personal_access_tokens`; looked up by SHA-256 hash match on every request.
- Both are resolved by `backend/auth/middleware.py:get_current_user` FastAPI dependency.
- Session cookie (`session_token`) is also checked as fallback for browser-native requests.

## Database

- Path: `backend/data/itracker.db` (configurable via `DB_PATH` env var).
- Schema: `backend/db/schema.sql` — single source of truth.
- Init: `backend/db/init_db.py` — runs schema on startup, idempotent.
- Connection: `backend/db/connection.py` — thread-local with WAL + FK enforcement.

## FTS5 Search Index Strategy

Two FTS5 virtual tables with content tables and triggers:
- `issues_fts(title, description)` — content=issues
- `comments_fts(body)` — content=comments

Triggers on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE keep FTS in sync automatically.

Search query: `SELECT issues.* FROM issues JOIN issues_fts ON issues.rowid = issues_fts.rowid WHERE issues_fts MATCH ?`

Operator parsing (`status:`, `priority:`, `assignee:me`, `label:`, `"phrase"`, `-label:`) is handled in `backend/routers/search.py` by the search feature leaf.

## WebSocket Channel Naming

```
ws/{workspace_slug}/issue/{identifier}         # e.g. ws/acme/issue/ENG-42
ws/{workspace_slug}/team/{team_id}/board       # kanban live updates
ws/{workspace_slug}/team/{team_id}/cycles      # cycle updates
ws/{workspace_slug}/notifications/{user_id}    # per-user inbox push
```

Feature leaves call `websocket_server.broadcast(channel, event_type, payload)` to push events.
Import: `from websocket_server import broadcast` (call with `asyncio.create_task` or from async context).

## Backend Router Auto-Discovery

`backend/main.py` scans `backend/routers/*.py` at startup and includes any module that exports `router: APIRouter`. **Feature leaves drop router files here — no manual registration needed.**

All routes use prefix `/api/v1`.

## Frontend Extension Points

Feature leaves:
1. Add page components under `frontend/src/features/{feature-name}/`
2. Register routes by pushing to `featureRoutes` in `frontend/src/routes/featureRoutes.ts`
3. **Do NOT edit `App.tsx` or any scaffold file.**

## Email Service (Dev)

`backend/email_service.send_email(to, subject, html_body, text_body)` prints full HTML + text to stdout. Replace the function body with real SMTP for production.
